spiritgiven.comments: It was a really good spirit since the game. Even if the score was hard, they never gave up and they smiled during all the game. Good luck for next games !
It was a game with high intensity. The communication was really clear and the spirit of the game was good.

The game was really cool ! There were high intensity and clean defenses. Good luck for the next game !

SD director note - FRA mixed came to me to discuss score. Actually should be a 1 for attitude and self control, not a 3. Cannot change the score but noted comments. Positive attitude and self-control was poor because FRA felt that some of the calls were unnecessary or not good, and the discussion was too long because SGP did not want to retract or contest the call. Otherwise it was a good match.

Le match était bien mais il y avait beaucoup de contacts évitables. Les signes n'étaient pas toujours visibles et les discussions un peu longues.
The match was good but there were a lot of avoidable contacts. The signs were not always visible and the discussions a bit long.

spiritreceived.comments: Such a nice first game! We loved your vibes and how you listened to us during the calls! We thought you were very fair and we motivate you to keep this up!
There was some dangerous plays in the first half but after communicating, they made safer plays and overall kept good body control.
4. Really positive attitude towards both teams and the sideline players were supportive of both sides no matter who scored. Thank you France and Good Luck!!

France Mixed, Thank you very much for this hard fought game. We as a team really enjoyed playing you. Spirit wise it was a very clean game, with little to no unneeded contact and nice communication. You deserved the win and we hope to see you play in the final. Thanks again and good luck
